name: komdosh-dev-spring-quality
description: Audits and QA artifacts on top of spring-core. Finds out what is actually true about a finished service: which routes are unauthenticated, what leaks through error bodies, whether JWT validation is real, where personal data escapes in logs and events, and which vendor types have leaked into application code. Also generates the QA artifacts a human tester needs — a validation checklist, a Newman-runnable Postman collection, and a self-contained HTML console — from one API-surface discovery. Read-only on the audit side: never edits, never extracts a secret, never prints personal data. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
